transcript.message:
Here's our baggage policy:

Every passenger can bring one cabin bag free of charge, up to 8kg and measuring 55x40x20cm, plus one personal item up to 40x30x15cm.

For hold baggage, the allowance depends on your fare class. Economy Light fares include no checked bags, Economy fares include one 23kg bag, and Business fares include two 23kg bags. If you need additional hold bags, they cost €35 each when you add them online up to 4 hours before departure, or €50 if you add them at the airport.

If your bag weighs more than 23kg, you'll be charged €15 per kilogram for the excess weight. Bags that are oversized (larger than 158cm in total dimensions) incur a €75 charge.

Is there anything specific about baggage you'd like to know more about?
Perfect, that answers all my questions — so the cabin bag limit is 8kg, economy includes one checked bag, and excess weight is €15 per kilo. Thanks so much for your help!
You're welcome! You've got it exactly right. If you need anything else in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great flight!
